title: PANHA Real-Time Communication Platform
Description: An enterprise-grade real-time video conferencing and chat application. Architected with WebRTC for low-latency P2P video streaming and WebSockets for instantaneous messaging. Features include scalable room management, robust state handling, and a highly responsive, modern dark-mode UI ensuring a seamless, high-performance user experience.

title: AI-Powered Interview Insights Dashboard
Description: A sophisticated recruitment intelligence tool that analyzes candidate interviews to generate automated, actionable feedback. Engineered utilizing large language models (LLMs) and a robust data pipeline, it features dynamic radar charts, real-time performance metrics, and detailed candidate summaries wrapped in a sleek, accessible dashboard interface.

title: Enterprise Multi-Step Registration Workflow
Description: A highly scalable, secure B2B onboarding flow designed to streamline complex organizational registrations. Built with advanced form state management, modular validation schemas, and progressive UI/UX patterns. The system ensures high conversion rates by utilizing responsive glassmorphic components and granular error handling.

title: Automated Resume Parsing System
Description: A highly accurate document processing engine that extracts structured data from candidate resumes (PDF/DOCX) using advanced NLP techniques. The application seamlessly integrates the parsed data—such as skills, experience, and education—into an elegant, user-friendly interface, drastically reducing manual data entry for recruiters.
